title: ComfyUI custom-node bisect helper (manual halving search)
purpose: Implements the manual halving-search procedure documented in Comfy-Org/docs troubleshooting/custom-node-issues.mdx (commit 4a9f856b) as a reversible Bash/Python3 script. Adds a timestamped backup before first move, JSON session state, good/bad marking, automatic restore, and suspect identification. Baseline: users move folders by hand with no log and no undo path. Not tested on a live install; desk-built artifact only.
attribution: Procedure source: Comfy-Org/docs troubleshooting/custom-node-issues.mdx at commit 4a9f856b (GPL-3.0). No page text reproduced.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
